WITH filtered_behavior AS (
  SELECT ab.abhvreg, ab.translink
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149
),
matched_records AS (
  SELECT fb.translink, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM filtered_behavior fb
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = fb.translink
  WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
),
counted_combos AS (
  SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as combo_count
  FROM matched_records
  GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist
),
totals_by_ordertype AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(combo_count) as ordertype_total
  FROM counted_combos
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  cc.translink,
  cc.ordertypedist,
  cc.combo_count,
  CAST(cc.combo_count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(tbo.ordertype_total AS NUMERIC) as fraction
FROM counted_combos cc
JOIN totals_by_ordertype tbo ON cc.ordertypedist = tbo.ordertypedist
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;
